entry.confirm_signal: Two beeps 5 s after power-up at full throttle.
steps: Throttle full, transmitter on, connect battery.
Throttle to off (towards you): two beeps.
Throttle to full: two beeps (brake now on).

announce.description: Each stick movement is acknowledged with the same number of beeps: 2 beeps while setting brake on, 1 beep while setting brake off. At normal power-up with the stick at off or brake the ESC beeps once (brake off) or twice (brake on); a second set follows when the stick goes to full.

select.description: The procedure toggles the stored brake state: stick off, then full, then off.

skip.description: Skip programming by powering up with the stick at off or brake.

scheme.confirm_signal: Two beeps for brake on or one beep for brake off at each of three stick moves; four beeps at the end (armed).
scheme.exit: After the four arming beeps the ESC is armed and programming is finished.
scheme.description: Full throttle at power-up for 5 s, off, full, off toggles the brake. The beep count per move (2 or 1) tells the new state; four beeps mean armed. Normal power-up at stick off beeps the stored state.

items.name: Brake

values.name: brake off (1 beep per move), factory default

items.note: Number is the beep count per stick move.

unknowns: Beep duration, gap and the 5 s hold tolerance: not stated.
Whether the repeat procedure always inverts the stored state: manual says 'repeat the process' to switch the brake off.
BEC type for SS-8 to SS-45D: not stated.
SS-60 and SS-80 settings other than brake (direction, timing 12 or 20 degrees, frequency 8 or 16 kHz, cutoff 5.6-37.0 V) need the Programming Card GPMM1895; no stick procedure given.
Cell and voltage limits: SS-8 to SS-45 list 2-4 LiPo; SS-45D lists 4 LiPo; SS-60 and SS-80 list 4-12 LiPo cells (12.4-50 V). v_min of 12400 mV is the manual's own number.
notes: The two manuals give the same brake procedure; GreatPlanes_Electrifly_SS-60_SS-80.pdf adds that the brake state is stored until changed.
Low-voltage cutoff differs: battery voltage x 0.67 in GreatPlanes_Electrifly_SilverSeries.pdf, battery voltage x 0.74 in GreatPlanes_Electrifly_SS-60_SS-80.pdf.
